caption: FIGURE 1.14
note: Caption is printed in blue small-caps as "FIGURE 1.14"; the body text refers to it as "Fig. 1.14". Printed subscripts are written with underscore notation (E_1C = E with subscript 1C, q_1 = q with subscript 1, etc.) because the field-vector labels use capital-letter subscripts that have no plain-text subscript form; on the page the E and q symbols are bold/italic respectively. Labels are listed top-left to bottom-right: the three E labels at apex C, the two slant-side "0.1 m" dimensions, then the baseline row (E_B, B, q_1, A, E_A, q_2), then the three "0.05 m" baseline dimensions. The three "0.1 m"/"0.05 m" repetitions are each printed separately on the artwork and are kept as separate entries. Excluded as outside target_box_in_crop and belonging to other blocks: the "Example 1.9 Two point charges ..." problem text above the artwork and the "Solution The electric field vector ..." text and equation below it.
